unitemized.reason: This only applies if visual assets exist. The reference language can't tell whether visual files are present (it can only tell whether the directory exists), so there's no applies_when condition for it.
API naming standard. It only applies if the change adds API endpoints, and judging naming consistency needs semantic reading of the code. No deterministic kind can do that.
API standard (plural resource nouns). It only applies to new endpoints and needs semantic review of the code, which no kind can express.
API standard (nesting depth). It only applies if endpoints are added, and the condition can't be expressed as a predicate.
Migration standard. It only applies if migrations are written, and checking for down methods needs reading the code semantically.
Model/table naming standard. It only applies if models are added and needs semantic review of the code.
Table timestamps standard. It only applies if tables are added and needs semantic review of the code.
Query safety standard. It only applies if database queries are written and needs semantic code analysis.
SQL interpolation ban. It only applies if queries are written and needs semantic code analysis that no kind expresses.
SELECT * standard. It only applies if queries are written and needs semantic code analysis.
Frontend accessibility standard. It only applies if UI is changed and needs semantic review.
